<!DOCTYPE html PUBLIC "-//W3C//DTD HTML 4.01 Transitional//EN" "http://www.w3.org/TR/html4/loose.dtd">

<html>

<head>

<meta http-equiv="Content-Type" content="text/html; charset=UTF-8">

<title>Query doctor</title>

</head>

<body bgcolor="#FFFFFF">

<table width="770" height="423" border="0" align="center" cellpadding="0" cellspacing="1" bgcolor="#000000">

<tr>

<td height="421" bgcolor="#FFFFFF"><%@ include file = "../include/head.inc" %>

<table width="770" height="290" border="0" align="center" cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0">

<tr>

<%@ include file = "../include/patient.inc" %>

<td width="603" align="center" valign="top">

<table width="100%" height="85%" border="0" cellpadding="3" cellspacing="1" bgcolor="#666666">

<tr>

<td width="100%" height="400" align="center" valign="top" bgcolor="E3EDFF">

<br>

<form action="/hospital/allAction.do?method=patientQueryMessage" method="POST">

<p>Departments<select name="section">

                                          <option value="se">Please select&nbsp;&nbsp;</option>

                                          <c:forEach var="section" items="${sections}">

                                          <option value="${section}">${section}</option>

                                          </c:forEach>

                            </select>

</p>

<p>Job title<select name="level">

                                          <option value="le">Please select&nbsp;&nbsp;</option>

                                          <c:forEach var="l" items="${levels}">

                                                        <option value="${l}">${l}</option>

                                          </c:forEach>

                 </select>

</p>

<p>Good at<select name="spe">

                                          <option value="nn">Please select&nbsp;&nbsp;</option>

                                          <c:forEach var="sp" items="${spes}">

                                                        <option value="${sp}">${sp}</option>

                                          </c:forEach>

<!DOCTYPE beans PUBLIC "-//SPRING//DTD BEAN//EN"

"http://www.springframework.org/dtd/spring-beans.dtd">

<beans>

<!--  DataSource -->

<bean id="dataSource" class="org.apache.commons.dbcp.BasicDataSource">

<property name="driverClassName">

<value>com.mysql.jdbc.Driver</value>

</property>

<property name="url">

<value>jdbc:mysql://localhost/tarena</value>

</property>

<property name="username">

<value>root</value>

</property>

<property name="password">

<value>root</value>

</property>

</bean>

<!--  session factory -->

<bean id="sessionFactory" class="org.springframework.orm.hibernate3.LocalSessionFactoryBean">

<property name="dataSource">

<ref bean="dataSource" />

</property>

<property name="hibernateProperties">

<props>

<prop key="hibernate.dialect">

org.hibernate.dialect.MySQLDialect

</prop>

<prop key="hibernate.hbm2ddl.auto">create</prop>

<prop key="hibernate.show_sql">true</prop>

<!-- <prop key="hibernate.format_sql">false</prop>-->

</props>

</property>

<property name="mappingResources">

<list>

<value>com/kettas/entity/hosp.hbm.xml</value>

</list>

</property>

</bean>

<!--  dao hibenate impl extends HibernateDaoSupport-->

<ref bean="sessionFactory" />

</property>

<ref bean="sessionFactory" />

</property>

</property>

<property name="sessionFactory">

<ref bean="sessionFactory" />

</property>

</bean>

<bean id="patientDao" class="com.abd.dao.impl.PatientDaoImpl">

<property name="sessionFactory">

<ref bean="sessionFactory" />

</property>

</bean>

<bean id="pinqueueDao" class="com.abd.dao.impl.PinqueueDaoImpl">

<property name="sessionFactory">

<ref bean="sessionFactory" />

</property>

</bean>

<!--target-->

<bean id="adminTarget" class="com.abd.biz.impl.AdminBizImpl">

<property name="daoA">

<ref bean="adminDao" />

</property>

<property name="daoB">

<ref bean="doctorDao" />

</property>

<property name="daoC">

<ref bean="appointmentDao" />

</property>

<ref bean="curappointmentDao" />

</property>

</bean>

<ref bean="doctorDao" />

<ref bean="curappointmentDao" />

</property>

<property name="daoP">

<ref bean="patientDao" />

</property>

<ref bean="historyDao" />

<ref bean="pinqueueDao" />

<script>

var speed=30//

gun2.innerHTML=gun1.innerHTML

function Marquee3(){

if(gun2.offsetWidth-gun.scrollLeft<=0)

gun.scrollLeft-=gun1.offsetWidth

else{

gun.scrollLeft++

}

}

var MyMar3 = setInterval(Marquee3,speed)

gun.onmouseover=function() {clearInterval(MyMar3)}

gun.onmouseout=function() {MyMar3=setInterval(Marquee3,speed)}

</script>
